Automated monitoring rules: immediate cohort reversion if cohort complaints >0.25% (recent‑abandoners slice) or >0.4% (other cohorts), or opt‑outs rise >40% vs baseline; pause all gated sends platform‑wide if complaints >0.75% or increase >30% vs this window; cap touches at 3 per user and suppress on opt‑out/complaint.  
Begin now, monitor hourly with auto‑scaling to top channel/segment combos, run immediate rollback on any threshold breach, and send a 3‑hour KPI snapshot plus mitigation plan to the client.
